text: Imagine that you are Andres, boasting to a friend later in the day.
Examiner’s
Write an account of the practical joke you played.
In your account, you should explain:
• the setting for the practical joke
• how you were able to carry out the trick
• why you enjoy playing jokes of this sort.
Base your account on what you have read in Passage A. Address all three bullet points.
Be careful to use your own words.
Begin your account, ‘Now you’ll want to hear all about my greatest trick ever …’.
Write between 1½ and 2 sides, allowing for the size of your handwriting.
Up to 15 marks are available for the content of your answer, and up to 5 marks for the
quality of your writing.
